prompt_md: 100 noodles in a bowl. You tie random pairs of loose ends together until none are left. On average, how many loops do you end up with?
prompt_short: 100 noodles; tie random pairs of ends until none are loose. Average loops?
hint_md: Each tie either closes a loop or makes one longer noodle.
explain_intuition_md: Each tie either closes a noodle into a loop or joins two noodles into one longer one. With k noodles left, only 1 tie in 2k − 1 closes a loop, so loops are rare until the very end. Adding up those small chances from 100 noodles down to 1 gives about 3.3 loops.
